title: 第十四章 心动的条件
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
在他通过以后，秦天没有急于下一步的反应，因为这是对方主动添加自己，必然是有事情，有些东西想要商量。

    而他之所以会答应，倒并不是因为想要放弃这个水系元素石，对他来说，这东西的重要程度自然不言而喻。

    之所以通过，是他有想到，对方现在既然能拿出这样的条件，那应该也将领地发展的不错。

    在这个情况下，对方愿意拿出一些东西？

    那这就很值得商榷了！

    他判断，接下来对方应该会拿出相应的好处，想要把这颗水系元素石给拿走。

    所以他才通过这个好友申请，就是想看看对方能给出怎样的价格。

    想看看，对方的职业应该也不差，这时候，要想从自己手上拿走自己认为价值至少值2000领主币的东西。

    那不付出点儿代价能行吗？

    虽然水系元素石是很重要，但是也可以看看到底对方能给出什么样的筹码，如果筹码合适的话，也不是不能考虑。

    这就是现在秦天心里面的大概想法。

    通过好友申请以后，他并没有着急，他知道对方大概率是在措辞，所以他先不着急。

    过了一会儿，他的眼前就浮现出了叶洛璃发来的信息。

    【你好，这颗元素石真的对我很重要，如果愿意割爱，我可以拿制造图纸来换！】

    另外那边叶洛璃的表情也略显迟疑。

    她其实是不想拿图纸来进行交换的。

    毕竟，这都是自己在之前辛苦击杀凶兽才在系统那边获得的奖励，这个奖励就连自己都很心痛，宝贝的不得了。

    根本就不舍得拿来换，这是之后长期发展所需要的东西！

    可是，现在的自己也确实拿不出更多的领主币了，这是一个很严肃的问题。

    如果把自己先前击杀的凶兽的一阶兽核直接选择回收的话，倒是能够继续往上加一节价格。
content_en:
After he passed, Qin Tian did not rush to the next step, because the other party took the initiative to add him, so there must be something and something he wanted to discuss.

    And the reason why he agreed was not because he wanted to give up this water element stone. To him, the importance of this thing was naturally self-evident.

    The reason why he passed it was that he thought that since the other party could come up with such conditions, he should also develop the territory well.

    In this case, is the other party willing to offer something?

    Then this is very debatable!

    He judged that the other party would come up with corresponding benefits next and wanted to take away the water element stone.

    That's why he applied through this friend request just to see what kind of price the other party could offer.

    I want to see if the other party's profession is not bad. At this time, I want to take something from my hand that I think is worth at least 2,000 lord coins.

    Can it be done without paying a price?

    Although the water element stone is very important, you can also see what kind of chips the other party can give. If the chips are suitable, it is not impossible to consider.

    This is the general thought in Qin Tian's heart now.

    After applying as a friend, he was not in a hurry. He knew that the other party was probably talking, so he didn't worry.

    After a while, a message from Ye Luoli appeared in front of his eyes.

    [Hello, this elemental stone is really important to me. If you are willing to part with it, I can exchange it for the manufacturing blueprint! 】

    In addition, Ye Luoli's expression over there was also slightly hesitant.

    She actually didn't want to exchange the drawings.

    After all, this is the reward I got from the system after working hard to kill the ferocious beast. This reward even makes me feel heartbroken, it's so precious.

    I am not willing to exchange it at all. This is something that is needed for long-term development in the future!

    However, now I really can't get more Lord Coins. This is a very serious problem.

    If you directly choose to recycle the first-level beast core of the ferocious beast you killed earlier, you can continue to increase the price by one.
